name: prototypes-spec
displayName: 原型→开发交付物生成器
description: 从原型工具导出的 HTML 中自动识别页面结构，生成 PRD、功能清单、测试用例、系统概要说明书、详细说明书、数据库设计说明书、试运行报告、维护手册、操作手册、应用软件清单、系统参数配置说明、培训计划、服务计划、功能与性能测试报告等开发交付物
description_en: Parse prototype HTML exports to auto-generate PRD, feature lists, test cases, system overview, detailed design, database design, trial run report, maintenance manual, operation manual, application inventory, system parameter configuration, training plan, service plan, and combined functional/performance test report
author: WikkyGao

scripts.test: echo "See scripts/ for Python-based generators" && exit 0
